title: Hybridization Chain Reaction (HCR) Protocol for Mouse Embryo Tails
author: Paul Gerald Layague Sanchez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7pyhmpw

steps.title: Rehydrate Samples
steps.instruction: Rehydrate samples (one sample per PCR tube, max capacity 200 µL) using a series of graded methanol : PBST (PBS + 0.1% Tween) washes.

steps.title: Proteinase K Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat samples with 10 ug/mL proteinase K (Merck, CAS # 38450-01-6) for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: First PBST Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with PBST twice, for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Initial Fixation
steps.instruction: Fix samples in 4% formaldehyde (prepared by diluting 2.16 mL 37% formaldehyde to 20 mL with PBST) for 20 minutes at room temperature. Pre-warm probe hybridization (PH) buffer at 37 °C for later use.

steps.title: Second PBST Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with PBST three times, for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: PH Buffer Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with PH buffer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Overnight Fixation
steps.instruction: Recover samples, wash quickly with cold PBS, and fix in 4% formaldehyde (prepared by diluting 1.08 mL 37% formaldehyde to 10 mL with PBS). Keep in formaldehyde overnight (approx. 16 hours) at 4 °C in the cold room with gentle shaking/rolling.

steps.title: Third PBST Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with PBST (0.1% Tween20 in 1x PBS) twice, for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Dehydrate Samples
steps.instruction: Dehydrate samples (one sample per tube) using a series of graded methanol : PBST (PBS + 0.1% Tween) washes.

steps.title: Cold Storage
steps.instruction: Incubate samples at -20 °C overnight (approx. 16 hours) or until use.

steps.title: Prepare Probe Solution
steps.instruction: Put fresh PH buffer into the tubes and incubate for 30 minutes at 37 °C. Prepare the probe solution by adding 2 pmol (2 µL of 1 µM stock) of odd probe mixture and 2 pmol of even probe mixture to every 500 µL of pre-warmed PH buffer.

steps.title: Probe Hybridization
steps.instruction: Remove PH buffer and add the probe solution. Incubate overnight (approx. 16 hours) at 37 °C.

steps.title: Buffer Equilibration
steps.instruction: Pre-warm probe wash buffer at 37 °C and equilibrate amplification buffer to room temperature.

steps.title: Probe Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with probe wash buffer at 37 °C four times, for 15 minutes each.

steps.title: SSCT Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with 5x SSCT (0.1% Tween20) at room temperature twice, for 5 minutes each. (To prepare 500 mL of 5x SSCT: dilute 125 mL of 20x SSC and 0.5 mL Tween20 to 500 mL with distilled H2O).

steps.title: Prepare Hairpin Mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare the hairpin mixture (30 pmol of each hairpin in 500 µL mixture) by mixing snap-cooled hairpins h1 and h2 into amplification buffer at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: In separate tubes, for every 500 µL hairpin mixture, prepare 30 pmol of hairpin h1 (15 µL of 2 µM stock or 10 µL of 3 µM stock) and 30 pmol of hairpin h2.
Snap-cool hairpins by heating tubes at 95 °C for 1.5 minutes.
Cool to room temperature in the dark for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Amplification Buffer Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with pre-equilibrated amplification buffer for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Hairpin Amplification
steps.instruction: Remove amplification buffer from sample tubes and add the hairpin mixture. Incubate overnight (approx. 16 hours) in the dark at room temperature. (Note: For dHCR imaging, use a shorter amplification period to ensure single-molecule dots are diffraction-limited).

steps.title: Post-Amplification Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with 5x SSCT for 30 minutes in the dark at room temperature.

steps.title: DAPI Nuclear Staining
steps.instruction: Stain nuclei with 1:1000 DAPI (5 ug/mL; 20 µL of 5 mg/mL DAPI diluted to 20 mL with 5x SSCT) in the dark at room temperature. Perform three washes with DAPI, each for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Final Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with 5x SSCT in the dark at room temperature twice, for 30 minutes each.

steps.title: Optional Sample Clearing
steps.instruction: Clear samples using fructose-glycerol clearing solution. Incubate in the dark at 4 °C for at least 2 hours. This solution can also be used for mounting on microscope slides.

substeps.instruction: Prepare clearing solution by dissolving 29.72 g fructose in 33 mL glycerol and 7 mL water on a magnetic stirrer (start dissolution at least one day prior).
Store clearing solution in the dark at 4 °C for at most 1 month.
